claim: AWS Backup storage pricing is based on the amount of storage your backup data consumes, and the amount billed in a month is based on the average storage space used throughout the month, billed as GB-Month.

values.display: only incur data transfer charges when transferring data out of an AWS Region

evidence.quote: You only incur data transfer charges when transferring data out of an AWS Region and there are no charges for transfers within the same AWS Region.
